title: failedRecord
description: A report of one or more data failures during import.

id.description: Unique ID for the error report.

importJobId.description: UUID referencing the import job generation the report.

channelId.description: UUID referencing the configuration that defined the import job.

channelName.description: The name of the channel at the time the job was run.

recordNumber.description: The identifier assigned to this error report by Inventory Import.

timeStamp.description: The date and time the error occurred.

sourceFileName.description: The name of the uploaded source file containing the error, if filename provider by the uploader.

recordErrors.description: List of errors encountered during upsert or delete.

items.description: Report of an error encountered during upsert or delete.

typeOfRecord.description: Type of entity affected by the error, i.e. HOLDINGS_RECORD.

transaction.description: Type of transaction triggering the error.

message.description: Error message produced by the backend component reporting the error.

entity.description: The record that was affected by the error.

originalRecord.description: The original source record as plain text.

transformedRecord.description: The JSON outcome of the transformation of the original record.

metadata.description: For tagging records with current time and user ID on create or update.

createdDate.description: Time stamp for the records creation.

createdByUserId.description: ID of the user creating the record.

updatedDate.description: Time stamp for the most recent update of the record.

updatedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who most recently updated the record.
